comments.body:
Correct English name for this discovery: Warbling White Eye

Further Research Quest name: Further Research on the Round Bird
Skill requirement: r12 Ecological Research, r14 Biology, FRE(French)
Pre-requisite discovery: Long-tailed Tit discovery (from "A Small, Round Bird" quest) + Bush Warbler discovery (from "Heritor of the Divine Voice" quest)
Required Sophia rank: 4
Sophia cost: 400 points
